source.interface_status: Public no-authentication search interface on an official government domain; machine contract is not formally documented.

access_issue: On 2026-07-28, curl, Node fetch, the in-app browser and an isolated Crawl4AI 0.9.2 Chromium probe could not obtain a response from sousuo.www.gov.cn, www.mofcom.gov.cn or exportcontrol.mofcom.gov.cn. Crawl4AI successfully retrieved the control URL example.com, while all three government URLs failed with net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED and zero HTML. No search-engine result or third-party mirror was substituted for an official-source snapshot.

review_gate.rule: No candidate may enter the event ledger until the official interface is directly retrieved and each linked document is manually reviewed.
